item.title: Data-Driven Electrolyte Design by Electrotopological State Descriptors for Na-Ion Batteries with Minimal Solid-Electrolyte Interphase Dissolution
item.description:
با رویکرد داده‌محور مبتنی بر توصیفگر EState، الکترولیت‌هایی برای باتری Na-ion طراحی شد که انحلال SEI را به ۶٪ کاهش داده و بازده کولمبی نزدیک به واحد را ممکن ساخت.
Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work establishes the first quantitative, data-driven link between electrolyte physicochemical descriptors—specifically the solvent average electrotopological state (EState) index—and SEI dissolution in Na-ion batteries. High-EState electrolytes cut SEI dissolution to 6% of conventional levels, enabling 99.98% Coulombic efficiency over 1000 cycles in an all-earth-abundant full cell, providing general design principles for high-reversibility NIBs.
🏷 Na-ion battery · SEI dissolution · electrolyte design · electrotopological state · data-driven

item.title: Hexafluoroisopropanol-Regulated Interfacial Engineering for Rapid Electrochemical Hydrogen Storage of Pyridine
item.description:
اصلاح سطحی با HFIP روی کاتالیزور Co9Cu بازده فارادایک هیدروژناسیون پیریدین به پیپریدین را به 83% و نرخ 1.03 mmol h–1 cm–2 می‌رساند.
Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in using hexafluoroisopropanol (HFIP) interfacial modification on a Co9Cu catalyst to boost electrochemical pyridine hydrogenation. HFIP anions form a hydrophobic layer that suppresses hydrogen evolution and enriches pyridine via dipole interactions, achieving 83% Faradaic efficiency and 1.03 mmol h⁻¹ cm⁻². This enables rapid, reversible hydrogen storage in pyridine/piperidine LOHC systems, demonstrating practical potential at ampere-scale currents.
🏷 LOHC · pyridine hydrogenation · HFIP · Co9Cu catalyst · electrocatalytic hydrogenation

item.title: Electrochemo‐mechanical interactions in rechargeable batteries: Mechanisms, characterization, and multiscale regulation
item.description:
این مرور، برهم‌کنش‌های الکتروشیمیایی-مکانیکی در باتری‌های قابل شارژ را از سازوکار و مشخصه‌یابی چندمقیاسی تا تنظیم تنش و تخریب بررسی می‌کند.
InfoMat | ⭐ Review | 🔓 Open Access

item.description:

Advanced Science | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in using the differing electrolyte reactivities of organic and inorganic materials as a design principle: an electrolyte-facing LiFePO4 layer forms a stable CEI that protects the underlying iodine-doped nickel phthalocyanine. This enables 94.6% retention over 3000 cycles and, with more organic content, 427 mAh g−1 and 1091 Wh kg−1 with 93.9% retention over 2000 cycles—advancing stable, high-capacity hybrid cathodes.
